user.title: Steward
user.description: Exposes an MCP endpoint at /api/steward. AI clients authenticate through Home Assistant's own login, so there is no token to copy.

data_description.allow_write: Changing states, calling services, and editing the registries. Turn this off for an audit-only connection.
data_description.allow_destructive: Deleting configuration and restarting Home Assistant.
data_description.require_admin: Non-administrators get read-only access regardless of the settings above.
data_description.rate_limit: Maximum requests one client may make per window. A model retrying in a loop can otherwise saturate the instance.
data_description.rate_window: Length of the sliding window, in seconds.
